layout: - Phase 9 moved the arcade screens into solitaireplus/games/arcade/: hub_screens.py (token exchange, prize counter, trophy room), machine_select.py (the four opponent/difficulty pickers), machine_screens.py (the four machines in play; multi-screen modules keep loop_event_/loop_draw_ names; the machines' per-frame update calls with dt live in their loop_draw_ functions), machine_music.py (ARCADE_MACHINE_MUSIC_BY_STATE, read by the main loop). get_profile_avatar, get_event_ui_asset and get_cover_scaled_ui_asset stay in legacy.py (shared with career/profile). Engines: games/arcade/king_pong.py, battle_bosses_game.py, ace_invaders_game.py, suit_snake_game.py, support.py. The main loop (solitaireplus/app/loop.py) owns the frame clock (window.clock).

tasks.prompt: Fix B49 (fixed time step): the four machines are updated with a fixed 1/60 s per frame regardless of real frame time. Pass the real frame time from the loop's clock (the value window.clock.tick returns, in seconds; store it in state, e.g. state.frame_dt, set once per frame in app/loop.py), capped at 1/20 s, to each machine's update. Keep everything else in the frame order unchanged. Test, for each machine: one update with dt = 1/30 gives the same state as two updates of 1/60, within a small tolerance (seeded).

Fix B50 (Suit Snake races ahead after any pause): suit_snake_game.py's owed steps grow without limit because _last_step_at isn't clamped. After catching up 2 steps, set _last_step_at = now. Test: after a 3-second gap, then normal frames, the snake moves at its normal rate (no burst of extra steps).

Fix B51 (Suit Snake creates 2 fonts per token per frame): cache them (use solitaireplus.ui.text.get_font or a module-private holder - no 'global'); pixels unchanged. Test: drawing twice builds each font once; output identical.

Fix B52 (Ace Invaders rescales its background every frame): ace_invaders_game.py smoothscales the background each frame. Cache it per target size, like its own _fit_image. Pixels unchanged. Test: two draws call smoothscale for the background once; output identical.

Fix B53 (King Pong serve goes the wrong way): king_pong.py sets _pending_serve_to_player = bool(player_scored), contradicting the comment above it (the side that conceded serves / the ball goes to the player who did not score - read the comment and the serve code to get the intended direction). Invert it. Test: after the player scores, the next serve heads to the NPC.

Fix B54 (whole-pixel rounding): ace_invaders_game.py and king_pong.py keep positions in pygame Rects, so each frame's movement is rounded to whole pixels, losing 12-17% speed unevenly. Keep float positions (x, y attributes) and copy them into the Rects for drawing and collisions. Test: an object moving at a speed that is not a whole number of pixels per frame covers the expected distance over 60 frames (within 1 px).

Fix B55 (Ace Invaders shots during the wave break count against accuracy): designer default (Dan, 2026-11-15): shots fired during the wave-break pause don't count. Keep firing allowed if it is today, but don't count those shots in accuracy. Test: shots fired during the break do not change shots-fired/accuracy; shots in a wave do.

Fix B56 (Enter in King Pong forfeits mid-match): the King Pong screen's Enter handling ends the match mid-play. Enter must only work when the match is finished, like the other machines. Test: pressing Enter mid-match does nothing; after the match ends it continues as before.

Fix B57 (Suit Snake 'new high score' fires on the first card): suit_snake_game.py announces a new high score even with no previous score. Require a previous score above 0, like Ace Invaders does. Test: the first ever game shows no 'new high score' event; beating a previous score does.

Fix B58 (Battle Bosses font per frame): battle_bosses_game.py builds a font every frame in its draw. Cache it (ui_text.get_font or a module-private holder, no 'global'); pixels unchanged. Test: drawing twice builds the font once; output identical.
